description: This Java class defines an immutable event 'PolicyEntryModified' emitted after a 'PolicyEntry' has been modified within a policies management system. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing the modified policy entry, and serializing the event back to JSON. The class manages event metadata such as revision, timestamp, headers, and resource path, and extends a base event class.

classes.name: PolicyEntryModified
classes.description: An immutable event class indicating that a policy entry has been modified. It encapsulates the modified policy entry, event metadata, and provides serialization/deserialization methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods for creating instances of PolicyEntryModified with various parameter options, including deprecated string-based policy IDs and newer typed PolicyId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntryModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing the JSON fields and constructing the event.

methods.name: getPolicyEntry
methods.description: Returns the modified PolicyEntry associated with this event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the event's payload entity (the policy entry) into JSON suitable for schema versioning.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to this event's resource, based on the policy entry's label.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance of PolicyEntryModified with an updated revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of PolicyEntryModified with updated headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Adds the policy entry label and JSON representation to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate filtering.
